2026-2027.summary: Broadway League data for the week of 2026-09-27 reflects strong national demand across Bushnell's slate: *Maybe Happy Ending* and *Operation Mincemeat: A New Musical* both posted 34% and 168% gross increases respectively, each setting new all-time highs. *Oh, Mary!* reported a 49% gross decline but achieved a record 99.1% paid capacity, signaling consistent sellout-level demand despite lower week-over-week revenue.
